title: A chain-phase engine: 3.5·10^18 steps for 0LB1LF
text: A macro step for the chain phases of 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB1LF, where the accelerated simulator's jumps never fire: one increment of the halving chain is predicted by a learned radius-1 automaton and an affine step cost, each checked against exact increments. Up to 9.84·10<sup>17</sup>, every chain-phase exit is the same with and without macro steps. No halt in 3.5·10<sup>18</sup> steps (20 minutes; the C++ port took 65 minutes for 10<sup>18</sup>).
